proposed_comments.title: Reject non-pseudo cultures before pseudolocalizer writes

confidence.rationale: The exact upstream validation accepts en-US and path aliases before output/delete paths are computed; the validated suggestion rejects non-qps cultures while preserving qps-test.

proposed_comments.body:
**High:** `Assert-CultureName` currently accepts ordinary source cultures such as `en-US` and path-like aliases such as `.`, so `generate -Culture en-US` resolves an en-US RESW output back onto the source file and `clear -Culture en-US` can delete source RESW files. Please reject non-pseudo culture names before any write/delete path is computed.

```suggestion
    if (-not $Value.StartsWith('qps-', [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
        Write-Error "Pseudo-localization culture must start with 'qps-'."
        return $false
    }

    return $true
```

proposed_comments.title: Persist the accepted language after startup fallback

confidence.rationale: The exact upstream startup path applies a fallback language but leaves the failed persisted tag in settings; the validated suggestion reconciles settings to the accepted tag.
